Severity scan upper bound: sev4 jump +8.9dB vs sev3 (25.66->34.58) -> darkening stronger than sev3; test sev5 (c=0.5) to bracket optimum

Cross-family alternative: shift sev4 best=34.58dB but not >40; residual_intensity_corr=0.9362 (high) is consistent with multiplicative/gamma darkening of shadows (bright areas preserved, dark crushed) rather than additive V-shift -> test brightness_darken_gamma_HSV sev4 (gamma=2.7)

After pinning brightness=shift_HSV sev4 (34.58dB), re-test saturation at moderate severity: chroma_ratio=0.2891 may still indicate a real saturate_weaken step beyond V-scaling; earlier joint used wrong brightness severity -> try shift4+saturate_HSV2 (S scale 0.55)

Saturation step rejected twice (shift4+sat2=33.60 < shift4=34.58); gamma_HSV sev4 matched unique-value counts within 2-5% but PSNR low -> scan gamma severity down one notch (sev3, gamma=2.2) to test whether true darkening is multiplicative with intermediate strength

Order hypothesis: HSV saturation scaling first raises RGB mean of saturated regions (V unchanged), then V-shift darkens; chroma_ratio=0.2891 requires saturation loss. Previous joint tests used brightness-first order -> test saturation(sev3)-then-brightness(sev4)

Masking test from Step-1 DCT signal (dct_zero_ratio=0.8886, unique_G 241/254): block_boundary 0.9992 is inconclusive in a 67%-black image because blocking hides in flat black; JPEG is physically last -> test shift4+jpeg1

Cross-colorspace alternative: V-space shift sev4 best=34.58; RGB-constant shift (c=0.35*255) is the other additive-darkening subtype in x_distortion and yields similar mean shift -45 with heavy zero clipping; test sev5 upper bound

final_decision.rationale: Signal 重释: 初始将 gm_ratio=0.251 归因于暗化压缩梯度并排除 blur，但统计对比显示 target 相对 shift-darkening 拟合残差在 clip(0.669 vs 0.769)/unique_G(241 vs 153)/gm 上系统性偏移；gamma 家族保 unique/clip 但 gm 偏锐 (0.380 vs 0.251)。组合逐层验证: gamma_HSV:5 单步=43.97dB(全局统计全匹配但 gm 偏锐), 加 blur_gaussian:1 后 52.10dB, 反转顺序 blur_gaussian:1→gamma_HSV:5 达到 PSNR=inf + CI 10/10 -> 确定性双步(模糊→gamma 变暗), 像素级完全复现。saturation/contrast/JPEG/noise 均被 PSNR 或剥离残差排除 (噪声剥离残差=0)。
